description: Messages that reached a track but didn't make a row (no hack read them, or a rule blocked them), newest first, with why: up to 20 of the newest 50. Give from to see only one sender's (when fixing its hack, so the person's other mail stays out of this chat), and before (olderBefore) for the 50 above. Use them as examples for a hack's template, or to see why a hack stopped matching. These are the person's own emails: use them only for setting up their hacks.

before.description: olderBefore from the last call, for older messages.

from.description: Only messages from this address or domain, like "chase.com".
